_provenance: SHAPE MEASURED (eBay Sell Finances getTransactions response schema), PER-FEE SPLIT INFERRED. The fee TOTAL is pinned to the measured 603.14; how that total divides across FINAL_VALUE_FEE / fixed / promoted is a reconstruction at eBay's published card rate (13.25% + $0.30). Replace with the real payload from a REPORT ONLY run with EBAY_FINANCES_DUMP_TRANSACTIONS=true. See README.md.
_shapeNote: Fees hang off orderLineItems[].marketplaceFees[]. There is no top-level fees[] on a SALE. This is the field path the pre-D34 mapper missed.
_expectedFeeMapNote: D34 R2 (2026-09-01): paymentProcessingFee / adFee / otherFees were 0 here and that was wrong. This payload contains no line of those types, so their values are UNKNOWN. Writing 0 was the mapper's global-sighting fabrication, and this fixture pinned it. Under managed payments eBay generally folds processing into the final value fee and sends no separate line — 'no line' is not 'zero dollars'. If the real captured payload turns out to carry explicit 0.00 lines, THOSE become 0 here, because a stated zero is a fact.

invariants.feeTotalEqualsMeasured: finalValueFee + paymentProcessingFee + promotedListingFee + adFee + otherFees == 603.14 (nulls contribute nothing — they are absent lines, not zero-dollar ones)
invariants.netPayoutMatchesLedger: amount - totalFeeAmount == 2396.85, the value already stored in prod
invariants.comment: The first two hold for ANY correct split of 603.14, so they survive replacement by the real payload. The per-fee values in expectedFeeMap do not — that is deliberate.
